definition: Synthetic pre-RML amplitude and closure-phase records with full mixed covariance

simulation_stats.closure_data_representation: real-valued local closure coordinates, unwrapped about each wavelength--epoch POVM working point

receiver_cache.definition: Per-sample aggregate covariance in (full E edge amplitudes, C selected closure phases). The optimal_singlecopy and promoted_singlecopy entries share the same POVM hash at every sample.
receiver_cache.finite_block_caveat: Each 10-nm wavelength band retains its per-sample QLAN covariance and is inflated by an independently calibrated finite-n_s factor.  Each factor comes from a locally optimized q=2, n_s=3 overcomplete POVM at that band's near-transit working point and is shared only across epochs within the band.

simulation_stats.mixed_likelihood: full (E+C)x(E+C) covariance including amplitude-phase cross block
simulation_stats.source_spectral_model: component-resolved NGC4151 SED: for the final core+disk+BLR H-alpha source, core and disk receive only smooth optical continuum, while the broad H-alpha excess over that continuum is assigned to the BLR component

split_diagnostics.status: not used by the paired POVM benchmark

sample_stress_test.corrected_photon_budget_model: All three lower panels use the same 50:50 amplitude/phase resource split. Amplitude data span all E edges, whereas phase data span only the C-dimensional closure subspace. The first receiver is uniform edge-first, the second is the locally optimized single-copy POVM, and the third coherently lifts that same POVM's score fluctuations in n_s=3 collective blocks.
